question: Three point charges $q_1 = 2 \times 10^{-6}\text{ C}$, $q_2 = 3 \times 10^{-6}\text{ C}$ and $q_3 = -1 \times 10^{-6}\text{ C}$ are arranged such that each pair is separated by $0.30\text{ m}$. Calculate the potential energy of the system. Take $\frac{1}{4\pi\varepsilon_0} = 9 \times 10^9\text{ N m}^2\text{ C}^{-2}$.
